title: Reindexing sign-valued functions
statement: Given types $\iota$ and $\kappa$ and a bijection $e:\iota\to\kappa$, the induced bijection between sign-valued functions on these types sends $x$ to the function $k\mapsto x(e^{-1}(k))$.
